sentence.en: The store wants to lower the prices because there are too few customers.

at sætte.explanation: "At sætte" means "to put" or "to place" something somewhere: Jeg sætter bogen på hylden (I put the book on the shelf). Do not mix it up with at sidde (to sit), which describes where you already are. Sæt dig means "Sit down".

sentence.da: Jeg vil **sætte** koppen på bordet.
sentence.en: I want to put the cup on the table.

at sætte i gang.explanation: "At sætte i gang" means "to start" or "to launch", to get something running: Vi sætter projektet i gang (We are launching the project). When the thing starts by itself, use komme i gang: Projektet kommer i gang (The project gets going).

sentence.da: Når I er klar, vil jeg **sætte i gang**.
sentence.en: When you are ready, I will get things started.

at sætte ind.explanation: "At sætte ind" means "to put in", and also "to deposit": Jeg sætter pengene ind på kontoen (I put the money into the account). It can mean "to put into service": Vi sætter flere busser ind (We are putting more buses into service).

sentence.da: Jeg går i banken for at **sætte ind**.
sentence.en: I am going to the bank to make a deposit.

at sætte pris på.explanation: "At sætte pris på" means "to appreciate", to value what someone does or gives: Jeg sætter pris på din hjælp (I appreciate your help). Add stor (big) for more: Jeg sætter stor pris på det (I really appreciate it).

sentence.da: Man skal **sætte pris på** sine venner.
sentence.en: You should appreciate your friends.

at sætte på.explanation: "At sætte på" means "to put on" for music, a pot or the heat: Jeg sætter kaffe på (I am putting coffee on). For clothes, use at tage tøj på (to put on clothes).

sentence.da: Skal jeg **sætte på**, så vi kan få te?
sentence.en: Shall I put the kettle on so we can have tea?

at sætte sig.explanation: "At sætte sig" means "to sit down": Jeg sætter mig i sofaen (I sit down on the sofa). To say you are already sitting, use at sidde (to sit): Jeg sidder i sofaen (I am sitting on the sofa).

sentence.da: Han vil **sætte sig** på stolen.
sentence.en: He wants to sit down on the chair.

at søge.explanation: "At søge" means "to apply" and "to search": Jeg søger et job (I am applying for a job). To search for a thing, add efter: Jeg søger efter mine nøgler (I am searching for my keys).

sentence.da: Jeg vil **søge** et nyt job i København.
sentence.en: I want to apply for a new job in Copenhagen.

at søge efter.explanation: "At søge efter" means "to search for" something you want to find: Jeg søger efter mine nøgler (I am searching for my keys). Without efter, at søge is used to apply: Hun søger et job (She is applying for a job).

sentence.da: Jeg vil **søge efter** en billig lejlighed.
sentence.en: I want to search for a cheap apartment.

at søge ind på.explanation: "At søge ind på" means "to apply to" a school or a study program: Hun søger ind på universitetet (She is applying to the university). To apply for a job, say at søge et job (to apply for a job).

sentence.da: Min søster vil **søge ind på** universitetet i år.
sentence.en: My sister wants to apply to the university this year.

at søge job.explanation: "At søge job" means "to apply for a job", and also "to look for work": Jeg søger job som lærer (I am looking for a job as a teacher). For one specific position, say at søge en stilling (to apply for a position).

forms.en: I have applied for a job

sentence.da: Jeg vil **søge job** i en bank.
sentence.en: I want to apply for a job at a bank.

at søge om.explanation: "At søge om" means "to apply for", when you ask for something official: søge om tilladelse (apply for a permit), søge om støtte (apply for support). For a job, say at søge (to apply): søge et job (apply for a job).

sentence.da: Han skal **søge om** et visum i dag.
sentence.en: He has to apply for a visa today.

at sørge for.explanation: "At sørge for" means "to take care of" something: Jeg sørger for maden (I'll take care of the food). It also means "to make sure": Sørg for at låse døren (Make sure you lock the door).

forms.en: to make sure / take care of
I make sure / take care of
I made sure / took care of
I have made sure / taken care of

sentence.da: Jeg skal **sørge for** børnene i aften.
sentence.en: I'll take care of the children tonight.

en sadel.explanation: "En sadel" means "a saddle", the seat on a horse's back, held in place by a strap under its belly. A bike seat is called a sadel too.

sentence.da: Rytteren sidder i en **sadel** på hestens ryg.
sentence.en: The rider sits in a saddle on the horse's back.

en sag.explanation: "En sag" means "a matter" or "a case": Det er en vigtig sag (It is an important matter). At work or in court, it is a case: Advokaten arbejder på en sag (The lawyer is working on a case).

sentence.da: Politiet arbejder på en vigtig **sag**.
sentence.en: The police are working on an important case.

en sagsbehandler.explanation: "En sagsbehandler" means "a caseworker", a public employee who looks into your situation and decides on things like benefits or support. It is built from sag (case) and behandler (someone who handles).

sentence.da: Min **sagsbehandler** ringer, når hun har læst min ansøgning.
sentence.en: My caseworker will call when she has read my application.

en saks.explanation: "En saks" means "a pair of scissors". Danish treats it as one thing: Kan jeg låne din saks? (Can I borrow your scissors?)

sentence.da: Jeg klipper papir med en **saks**.
sentence.en: I cut paper with a pair of scissors.

en sal.explanation: "En sal" means "a hall", a big space for meetings, parties or shows. It is not a hallway; that is en gang (a hallway).

sentence.da: Koncerten foregår i den store **sal**.
sentence.en: The concert takes place in the big hall.

en salamander.explanation: "En salamander" means "a salamander", a small animal with a long tail that looks like a lizard but has smooth, moist skin instead of scales.

sentence.da: Man finder ofte en **salamander** under en sten ved vandet.
sentence.en: You often find a salamander under a rock by the water.

en salat.explanation: "En salat" means "a salad" and also "lettuce", so the situation tells you which one is meant.

sentence.da: Jeg spiser en **salat** med tomat og agurk.
sentence.en: I eat a salad with tomato and cucumber.

en saltbøsse.explanation: "En saltbøsse" means "a salt shaker", the small container you shake salt from at the table. It is built from salt (salt) and bøsse (a small can).

sentence.da: Jeg ryster salt på maden fra en **saltbøsse**.
sentence.en: I shake salt onto the food from a salt shaker.

en salve.explanation: "En salve" means "an ointment", a thick treatment you rub on the skin, such as for a rash or a sore muscle. The same word also means a volley: en salve skud (a volley of shots).

sentence.da: Lægen gav mig en **salve** til mit udslæt.
sentence.en: The doctor gave me an ointment for my rash.

en samlever.explanation: "En samlever" means "a live-in partner", someone you live with as a couple, even if you are not married. The word comes from sammen (together) and at leve (to live).

sentence.da: Min **samlever** og jeg bor sammen, men vi er ikke gift.
sentence.en: My partner and I live together, but we are not married.

en samling.explanation: "En samling" means "a collection", many things of one kind that you keep together, like stamps or books. In a kindergarten, samling is also the circle time when all the children gather.

sentence.da: Min onkel har en stor **samling** af gamle mønter.
sentence.en: My uncle has a big collection of old coins.

en sammenhæng.explanation: "En sammenhæng" means "a connection", the way two things belong together: Der er en sammenhæng mellem søvn og humør (Sleep and mood are related). It also means context: i den sammenhæng (in that context).

sentence.da: Der er en **sammenhæng** mellem rygning og lungesygdom.
sentence.en: There is a link between smoking and lung disease.

en sammenkomst.explanation: "En sammenkomst" means "a get-together", a calm gathering where people meet to talk, like a family afternoon or a work birthday. It is calmer than a lively fest (party), often just talk and something to drink.

sentence.da: Vi drak kaffe og spiste kage til en **sammenkomst** hos mormor.
sentence.en: We drank coffee and ate cake at a get-together at Grandma's.

en sammenligning.explanation: "En sammenligning" means "a comparison", looking at two things to see how they are alike or different. It is often used with mellem (between): en sammenligning mellem to byer (a comparison between two cities).

sentence.da: I **sammenligning** med Sverige er Danmark et lille land.
sentence.en: In comparison with Sweden, Denmark is a small country.

en sammensværgelse.explanation: "En sammensværgelse" means "a conspiracy", a plan made in hiding by a group of people to do something illegal or harmful, such as overthrowing a ruler.

sentence.da: Politiet afslørede en **sammensværgelse** mod kongen.
sentence.en: The police uncovered a conspiracy against the king.

en samtale.explanation: "En samtale" means "a conversation". It is built from sam- (together) and tale (talk). With telefon (phone) in front, it is a phone call: en telefonsamtale (a phone call).

sentence.da: To mennesker har en **samtale**, når de taler sammen.
sentence.en: Two people have a conversation when they talk together.

en samtaleøvelse.explanation: "En samtaleøvelse" means "a conversation exercise", an exercise where learners talk to each other, often in pairs, to practice speaking. It is built from samtale (conversation) and øvelse (practice).

sentence.da: I en **samtaleøvelse** taler vi sammen to og to.
sentence.en: In a conversation exercise, we talk together in pairs.

en samvittighed.explanation: "En samvittighed" means "a conscience", the inner voice that tells you whether something you did is right or wrong. A clear one is en ren samvittighed (a clear conscience).

sentence.da: Hun fik dårlig **samvittighed** efter løgnen.
sentence.en: She got a guilty conscience after the lie.

en sandal.explanation: "En sandal" means "a sandal". Sandals come in pairs, so you will often see et par sandaler (a pair of sandals).

sentence.da: En **sandal** er en åben sko til sommer.
sentence.en: A sandal is an open shoe for summer.

en sandhed.explanation: "En sandhed" means "a truth". It is built from sand (true), as in Det er sandt (That is true). It has nothing to do with sand (sand) in en sandstrand (a sandy beach).

sentence.da: Der er en **sandhed** i det, han siger.
sentence.en: There is a truth in what he says.

en sandkasse.explanation: "En sandkasse" means "a sandbox", where children play with sand. It is built from sand (sand) and kasse (box).

sentence.da: Barnet graver med en spade i en **sandkasse**.
sentence.en: The child digs with a shovel in a sandbox.

en sandstrand.explanation: "En sandstrand" means "a sandy beach". It is built from sand (sand) and strand (beach), and the same sand starts en sandkasse (a sandbox).

sentence.da: Børnene leger på den lange **sandstrand**.
sentence.en: The children play on the long sandy beach.

en sandsynlighed.explanation: "En sandsynlighed" means "a probability", how likely it is that something will happen. It is used with for (of): Der er lille sandsynlighed for fejl (There is a small probability of errors).

sentence.da: Der er stor **sandsynlighed** for sne i weekenden.
sentence.en: There is a high probability of snow this weekend.

en sandwich.explanation: "En sandwich" means "a sandwich", bread with a filling, closed on top. Smørrebrød (open sandwich) has no top slice of bread.

sentence.da: Jeg spiser en **sandwich** med ost og skinke.
sentence.en: I eat a sandwich with cheese and ham.

en sang.explanation: "En sang" means "a song", music with words. For music with no words, say et stykke musik (a piece of music).

sentence.da: Hun synger en smuk **sang** for os.
sentence.en: She sings a beautiful song for us.

en sangtekst.explanation: "En sangtekst" means "a song lyric", the words of a song. In everyday talk, tekst alone often means the same: Jeg kender ikke teksten (I do not know the lyrics).

sentence.da: Ordene i en **sangtekst** rimer ofte på hinanden.
sentence.en: The words in a song lyric often rhyme with each other.

en sanktion.explanation: "En sanktion" means "a sanction", a penalty for breaking rules. It also means the measures one country takes against another, usually in the plural: sanktioner mod Rusland (sanctions against Russia).

sentence.da: Landet får en hård **sanktion**, hvis det bryder reglerne.
sentence.en: The country gets a harsh sanction if it breaks the rules.

en sans.explanation: "En sans" means "a sense", one of the body's ways of noticing the world, like touch or taste. It also means a feel for something: sans for humor (a sense of humor).

sentence.da: Synet er en **sans**, og det er hørelsen også.
sentence.en: Sight is a sense, and hearing is too.

en satellit.explanation: "En satellit" means "a satellite", an object that travels around the Earth to send TV signals, phone calls or GPS.

sentence.da: En **satellit** i rummet sender billeder af vejret til Jorden.
sentence.en: A satellite in space sends pictures of the weather to Earth.

en sauna.explanation: "En sauna" means "a sauna", a hot room where you sit and sweat. After i (in), Danes often leave out the en: i sauna (in the sauna).

sentence.da: Efter træning sidder vi i **sauna** og sveder.
sentence.en: After working out, we sit in the sauna and sweat.

en scanning.explanation: "En scanning" means "a scan", a medical exam where a machine takes pictures of the inside of the body. Pregnant women get one too, to see the baby.

sentence.da: Lægen vil se indersiden af kroppen med en **scanning**.
sentence.en: The doctor wants to see the inside of the body with a scan.

en scene.explanation: "En scene" means "a stage" in a theater, and also "a scene" in a film or play: Sangeren står på scenen (The singer is standing on the stage). Scenen i filmen er sjov (The scene in the movie is funny).

sentence.da: Bandet spiller på en stor **scene** i aften.
sentence.en: The band is playing on a big stage tonight.

en scooter.explanation: "En scooter" means "a scooter" with a motor, like a small motorbike you sit on. For a kick scooter that you stand on, say et løbehjul (literally a running wheel).

sentence.da: Hun kører på **scooter** gennem byen.
sentence.en: She rides a scooter through town.

en score.explanation: "En score" means "a score", the count of how well each side or player did in a game. To score a goal, use at score: Han scorer et mål (He scores a goal).

sentence.da: Min **score** i spillet er meget høj.
sentence.en: My score in the game is very high.

en seddel.explanation: "En seddel" means "a note", a small piece of paper with writing. It is also a piece of paper money: en hundredkroneseddel (a 100-krone bill).

sentence.da: Jeg skriver en **seddel** og lægger den på døren.
sentence.en: I write a note and put it on the door.

en seer.explanation: "En seer" means "a viewer", someone who watches a TV show, a film or a video. It comes from at se (to see): Programmet har mange seere (The show has many viewers).

sentence.da: En **seer** ser programmet hjemme i sin sofa.
sentence.en: A viewer watches the show at home on their couch.

en sejlbåd.explanation: "En sejlbåd" means "a sailboat", a boat that the wind moves. It is built from sejl (sail) and båd (boat).

sentence.da: Når der er vind, sejler min onkel i sin **sejlbåd**.
sentence.en: When there is wind, my uncle sails in his sailboat.

en sejr.explanation: "En sejr" means "a victory", when you win. The opposite is et nederlag (a defeat), and the verb is at sejre (to win).

sentence.da: Vi fejrer vores store **sejr** med kage.
sentence.en: We celebrate our big victory with cake.

en sekretær.explanation: "En sekretær" means "a secretary", someone who handles calls, mail and meetings for a company.

sentence.da: Vores **sekretær** svarer i telefonen.
sentence.en: Our secretary answers the phone.

en sektion.explanation: "En sektion" means "a section", a part of a larger whole: en sektion af avisen (a section of the paper).

sentence.da: Børnebøgerne står i en anden **sektion**.
sentence.en: The children's books are in another section.

en sektor.explanation: "En sektor" means "a sector", a big part of society or the economy. A sector is far bigger than one workplace: it covers a whole kind of work, like health care or farming.

sentence.da: Skoler og hospitaler hører til den offentlige **sektor**.
sentence.en: Schools and hospitals belong to the public sector.

en sele.explanation: "En sele" means "a seat belt" or "a harness". To put it on, use at tage på (to put on): Tag selen på (Put your seat belt on). For a car, you can also say en sikkerhedssele (a safety belt).

sentence.da: Børnene skal have **sele** på i bilen.
sentence.en: The children must wear seat belts in the car.

en selvbetjeningskasse.explanation: "En selvbetjeningskasse" means "a self-checkout", a checkout in a store where you scan your own items and pay without help from staff. The word is built from selvbetjening (self-service) and kasse (checkout).

sentence.da: Ved en **selvbetjeningskasse** scanner du selv varerne og betaler.
sentence.en: At a self-checkout you scan the goods yourself and pay.

en senator.explanation: "En senator" means "a senator", a member of a senate, such as the one in the United States. Denmark has no senate, so you mostly meet the word when Danes talk about other countries.

sentence.da: Hun er **senator** for Texas og arbejder i Washington.
sentence.en: She is a senator for Texas and works in Washington.

en sending.explanation: "En sending" means "a shipment" and "a broadcast". With goods, it is a load that is on its way to someone. With radio and TV, it is one program that is aired.

sentence.da: Vi venter på en **sending** med varer fra Kina.
sentence.en: We are waiting for a shipment of goods from China.

en sene.explanation: "En sene" means "a tendon", the strong cord that joins a muscle to a bone. Do not mix it up with ledbånd (ligaments), which join one bone to another.

sentence.da: Den tykkeste **sene** i kroppen sidder lige over hælen.
sentence.en: The thickest tendon in the body is right above the heel.

en seng.explanation: "En seng" means "a bed". At gå i seng means "to go to bed", with no en in it: Jeg går i seng (I am going to bed).

sentence.da: Jeg er træt og går i **seng**.
sentence.en: I am tired and go to bed.

en sengegavl.explanation: "En sengegavl" means "a headboard", the board at the head end of a bed. It is senge (bed) plus gavl (end), and gavl is also the end wall of a house: gavlen på huset (the end wall of the house).

sentence.da: Jeg sidder i sengen og læner mig mod min **sengegavl**.
sentence.en: I sit in bed and lean against my headboard.

en sergent.explanation: "En sergent" means "a sergeant", a middle rank in the army. A sergeant gives orders to a small group and takes orders from higher ranks.

sentence.da: Som **sergent** leder han en lille gruppe i hæren.
sentence.en: As a sergeant he leads a small group in the army.

en serie.explanation: "En serie" means "a series", often a TV show. It also means a set of things in a row: en serie fejl (a series of mistakes).

sentence.da: Vi ser en god **serie** hver aften.
sentence.en: We watch a good series every evening.

en seriemorder.explanation: "En seriemorder" means "a serial killer", someone who kills several people at different times, often in the same way. Serie (series) is a row of things that follow one after another.

sentence.da: Filmen handler om en **seriemorder**, og politiet jagter ham.
sentence.en: The film is about a serial killer, and the police are hunting him.

en server.explanation: "En server" means "a server", a computer that sends data to other computers. In a restaurant, a waiter is en tjener instead.

sentence.da: Siden virker ikke, når vores **server** er nede.
sentence.en: The site does not work when our server is down.

en service.explanation: "En service" means "a service", help given to people in a shop, hotel or restaurant. A car also goes in for service: Bilen skal til service (The car has to go in for service). A favor is en tjeneste.

sentence.da: Vi fik rigtig god **service** på hotellet.
sentence.en: We got really good service at the hotel.

en serviet.explanation: "En serviet" means "a napkin", the cloth or paper you use at the table while eating. It is said ser-vi-ET, with the stress at the end.

sentence.da: Der ligger en **serviet** ved gaflen.
sentence.en: There is a napkin by the fork.

en servitrice.explanation: "En servitrice" means "a waitress", a woman who brings food and drinks to the guests in a restaurant. Today many people say en tjener (a waiter) for both women and men.

sentence.da: En **servitrice** tager imod bestillinger og serverer maden.
sentence.en: A waitress takes orders and serves the food.

en seværdighed.explanation: "En seværdighed" means "an attraction", a place worth seeing. It comes from se (see) and værdig (worthy).

sentence.da: Turisterne besøger hver **seværdighed** i byen.
sentence.en: The tourists visit every attraction in the city.

en sfo.explanation: "En SFO" means "an after-school club", a place where the youngest schoolchildren stay after lessons until someone picks them up. The letters stand for skolefritidsordning (school after-hours scheme), and you say them one by one: es-ef-o.

sentence.da: Min søn er i **SFO**, når skolen er slut.
sentence.en: My son is in the after-school club when school is over.

en shelter.explanation: "En shelter" means "a shelter", in Denmark a simple wooden hut in nature, open on one side. People sleep in it on hiking trips, often for free.

sentence.da: En **shelter** har tag og tre vægge, men ingen dør.
sentence.en: A shelter has a roof and three walls, but no door.

en sherif.explanation: "En sherif" means "a sheriff", the chief law officer of a county in the USA. Denmark has none, so you mostly meet the word in American films and news.

sentence.da: Hun er **sherif** og holder ro og orden i den lille by.
sentence.en: She is the sheriff and keeps order in the small town.

en si.explanation: "En si" means "a sieve" or "a strainer", a bowl-shaped mesh with small holes. It lets liquid or fine powder through and holds back the rest.

sentence.da: Jeg hælder te gennem en **si**.
sentence.en: I pour tea through a strainer.

en side.explanation: "En side" means "a page" or "a side", and also a web page. På den anden side means "on the other side" or "on the other hand", often after På den ene side (on the one hand).

sentence.da: Åbn bogen på **side** ti.
sentence.en: Open the book on page ten.

en sidebemærkning.explanation: "En sidebemærkning" means "a side note", a short extra point that is not part of the main message, added in passing in a talk or a text.

sentence.da: Hun kom med en **sidebemærkning** midt i foredraget.
sentence.en: She added a side note in the middle of the talk.

en sikkerhedskontrol.explanation: "En sikkerhedskontrol" means "a security check", for example at an airport, where your bag goes through a scanner. It is built from sikkerhed (security) and kontrol (check).

sentence.da: Alle skal igennem en **sikkerhedskontrol** i lufthavnen.
sentence.en: Everyone has to go through a security check at the airport.

en sikkerhedskopi.explanation: "En sikkerhedskopi" means "a backup", an extra copy kept in case something is lost. It is built from sikkerhed (security) and kopi (copy).

sentence.da: Når telefonen går i stykker, har jeg en **sikkerhedskopi**.
sentence.en: When the phone breaks, I have a backup.

en sikkerhedssele.explanation: "En sikkerhedssele" means "a seatbelt". It is built from sikkerhed (safety) and sele (harness). To say you wear it, use have sikkerhedsselen på (literally "have the seatbelt on"): Du skal have sikkerhedsselen på (You must wear your seatbelt).

sentence.da: En **sikkerhedssele** beskytter dig i bilen.
sentence.en: A seatbelt protects you in the car.

en sikring.explanation: "En sikring" means "a fuse", the small part that cuts the electricity if something goes wrong. It is built on at sikre (to secure).

sentence.da: Lyset gik ud, fordi en **sikring** var sprunget.
sentence.en: The light went out because a fuse had blown.

en sikringsboks.explanation: "En sikringsboks" means "a fuse box", the box with the switches that control the electricity in a home. When the electricity goes out, Danes say Strømmen er gået (literally the electricity has gone).

sentence.da: Lyset gik ud, og nu leder jeg efter vores **sikringsboks**.
sentence.en: The light went out, and now I am looking for our fuse box.

en situation.explanation: "En situation" means "a situation", how things are at a certain moment.

sentence.da: Det er en svær **situation** for alle.
sentence.en: It is a hard situation for everyone.

en sjæl.explanation: "En sjæl" means "a soul", the inner part of a person, often thought to live on after death. It can also stand for a single person: Der var ikke en sjæl (There was not a soul there).

sentence.da: Mange tror på, at man har en **sjæl**.
sentence.en: Many believe that you have a soul.

en skabning.explanation: "En skabning" means "a creature", a living thing. It comes from skabe (to create), so it hints at something that was made.

sentence.da: I eventyret møder drengen en mærkelig **skabning** i skoven.
sentence.en: In the fairy tale the boy meets a strange creature in the forest.

en skade.explanation: "En skade" means "an injury" and also "damage". Stormen gjorde stor skade (The storm did great damage).

sentence.da: Han fik en **skade** i knæet under kampen.
sentence.en: He got an injury to his knee during the game.

en skadestue.explanation: "En skadestue" means "an ER" (emergency room), where you go for injuries and sudden problems. It is made of skade (injury) and stue (room). Jeg er på skadestuen means "I am at the ER" (Danish says på, which literally means "on").

sentence.da: Læger hjælper skadede folk på en **skadestue**.
sentence.en: Doctors help injured people in an ER.

en skala.explanation: "En skala" means "a scale", a row of steps used to measure or rate something, for example from 1 to 10. For weighing yourself, Danes use en badevægt (a bathroom scale), not skala.

sentence.da: Hvor ondt gør det på en **skala** fra et til ti?
sentence.en: How much does it hurt on a scale from one to ten?

en skammel.explanation: "En skammel" means "a stool", a small seat with no back.

sentence.da: Jeg står på en **skammel** og når hylden.
sentence.en: I stand on a stool and reach the shelf.

en skandale.explanation: "En skandale" means "a scandal", something wrong that becomes public and shocks people. In everyday talk it can also be strong anger at something unfair: Det er en skandale, at bussen altid er forsinket! (It is a scandal that the bus is always late!)

sentence.da: Avisen skrev om en stor **skandale** i regeringen.
sentence.en: The newspaper wrote about a big scandal in the government.

en skat.explanation: "En skat" means "a tax". It also means "a treasure", and Danes call a loved one skat too: Hej skat (Hi, honey).

sentence.da: Vi betaler meget i **skat** i Danmark.
sentence.en: We pay a lot in tax in Denmark.

en skattejagt.explanation: "En skattejagt" means "a treasure hunt", a game where you follow hints to find something hidden. Skat means "treasure" here, but it also means "tax", so a skattejagt has nothing to do with taxes.

sentence.da: På en **skattejagt** følger man spor for at finde en skjult skat.
sentence.en: On a treasure hunt you follow trails to find a hidden treasure.

en skatteyder.explanation: "En skatteyder" means "a taxpayer", a person who pays tax to the state. In Danish news you often hear that something is paid by skatteyderne (the taxpayers), which means with public money.

sentence.da: Som **skatteyder** betaler man en del af sin løn til staten.
sentence.en: As a taxpayer you pay part of your salary to the state.

en ske.explanation: "En ske" means "a spoon". En teske (a teaspoon) and en spiseske (a tablespoon, literally an eating spoon) are built from it.

sentence.da: Jeg spiser suppen med en **ske**.
sentence.en: I eat the soup with a spoon.

en ski.explanation: "En ski" means "a ski". With more than one, the word often stays ski: Jeg har to nye ski (I have two new skis).

sentence.da: Min ene **ski** er gået i stykker.
sentence.en: One of my skis has broken.

en skik.explanation: "En skik" means "a custom", a shared way of doing things in a country or group, for example how people greet or celebrate. A well-known saying is Andre lande, andre skikke (Other countries, other customs).

sentence.da: Det er en gammel **skik** at tænde lys i vinduet i december.
sentence.en: It is an old custom to light candles in the window in December.

en skildpadde.explanation: "En skildpadde" means "a turtle", and Danish uses the same word for a tortoise on land. Its shell is en skal (a shell).

sentence.da: En **skildpadde** går langsomt, men den bliver gammel.
sentence.en: A turtle walks slowly, but it gets old.

en skildring.explanation: "En skildring" means "a depiction", a detailed, lifelike presentation in words, film or painting. It is common when talking about books and films, and it goes with af (of): en skildring af byen (a depiction of the city).

sentence.da: Romanen er en levende **skildring** af livet på landet.
sentence.en: The novel is a lively depiction of life in the countryside.

en skilsmisse.explanation: "En skilsmisse" means "a divorce", when a married couple splits up. A person who has been through one is skilt (divorced).

sentence.da: Deres **skilsmisse** var svær for børnene.
sentence.en: Their divorce was hard on the children.

en skinke.explanation: "En skinke" means "a ham". Without en, skinke is the ham you put on bread or in a meal: et stykke skinke (a piece of ham), brød med skinke (bread with ham).

sentence.da: **Skinke** er kød fra en gris.
sentence.en: Ham is meat from a pig.

en skinne.explanation: "En skinne" means "a splint" and "a rail". Both are a long, stiff strip: a train runs on two steel ones, and the other kind holds a broken bone still.

sentence.da: Lægen satte en **skinne** på hendes brækkede finger.
sentence.en: The doctor put a splint on her broken finger.

en skive.explanation: "En skive" means "a slice", for example of bread, cheese or sausage: en skive brød (a slice of bread). For a slice of cake, Danes usually say et stykke kage (a piece of cake).

sentence.da: Jeg skærer en **skive** af brødet.
sentence.en: I cut a slice off the bread.

en skjorte.explanation: "En skjorte" means "a shirt". The j in skjorte is said like an English y.

sentence.da: En **skjorte** har knapper og lange ærmer.
sentence.en: A shirt has buttons and long sleeves.

en sko.explanation: "En sko" means "a shoe". The word for more than one shoe looks the same as the single word, so you tell them apart with a number: to sko means "two shoes".

sentence.da: Jeg har kun en **sko** på.
sentence.en: I only have one shoe on.

en skobutik.explanation: "En skobutik" means "a shoe store". It is made of sko (shoes) and butik (shop), and butik is also in en bogbutik (a bookstore).

sentence.da: Jeg køber nye sko i en **skobutik**.
sentence.en: I buy new shoes in a shoe store.

en skole.explanation: "En skole" means "a school". To say that someone is at school, Danes say i skole with no en or "the": Børnene er i skole (The children are at school).

sentence.da: Min datter går i **skole** hver dag.
sentence.en: My daughter goes to school every day.

en skole-hjem-samtale.explanation: "En skole-hjem-samtale" means "a parent-teacher conference", a talk at school about one child, where the family hears how the child is doing. It is only about your own child, not about the whole class.

sentence.da: Vi taler med læreren om vores søn til en **skole-hjem-samtale**.
sentence.en: We talk with the teacher about our son at a parent-teacher conference.

en skoledag.explanation: "En skoledag" means "a school day", a day when children go to school. Unlike en fridag (a day off), it is a day with lessons.

sentence.da: Efter en lang **skoledag** er børnene trætte og sultne.
sentence.en: After a long school day the children are tired and hungry.

en skolegård.explanation: "En skolegård" means "a schoolyard", the outdoor area at a school where children play and run around between lessons. It is built from skole (school) and gård (yard).

sentence.da: Børnene leger i en stor **skolegård** mellem timerne.
sentence.en: The children play in a big schoolyard between classes.

en skoletaske.explanation: "En skoletaske" means "a school bag", the bag a child carries on the back to school. It is built from skole (school) and taske (bag).

sentence.da: Børnene har bøger og madpakke i deres **skoletaske**.
sentence.en: The kids have books and a packed lunch in their school bag.

en skoletur.explanation: "En skoletur" means "a school trip", when a class travels together for a day or longer. It is built from en skole (a school) and en tur (a trip).

sentence.da: Hele klassen skal på **skoletur** til Berlin.
sentence.en: The whole class is going on a school trip to Berlin.

en skomager.explanation: "En skomager" means "a shoemaker" or "a cobbler", someone who makes and repairs shoes. The ending -mager means a maker of something.

sentence.da: Min **skomager** kan reparere hælen på mine sko.
sentence.en: My shoemaker can fix the heel on my shoes.

en skorsten.explanation: "En skorsten" means "a chimney", the tall pipe on a roof that carries smoke away from a fireplace or stove.

sentence.da: Der kommer røg op af vores **skorsten**.
sentence.en: Smoke is coming up out of our chimney.

en skorstensfejer.explanation: "En skorstensfejer" means "a chimney sweep", a worker who cleans the black dirt left by fires out of chimneys, so that smoke can leave safely and the house does not catch fire.

sentence.da: En **skorstensfejer** tjekker skorstenen i vores hus hvert år.
sentence.en: A chimney sweep checks the chimney in our house every year.

en skostørrelse.explanation: "En skostørrelse" means "a shoe size", the number inside your shoe. Denmark uses European sizes, so you say Jeg bruger størrelse 40 (I wear a size 40).

sentence.da: Min **skostørrelse** er 40, men skoene er for små.
sentence.en: My shoe size is 40, but the shoes are too small.

en skov.explanation: "En skov" means "a forest" or "woods". A walk in the woods is en skovtur (literally a forest trip).

sentence.da: Der er mange høje træer i en **skov**.
sentence.en: There are many tall trees in a forest.

en skovbrand.explanation: "En skovbrand" means "a wildfire", a large blaze that spreads through a forest. Denmark has few large ones, but the word is common in news about other countries, such as Australia and California.

sentence.da: En **skovbrand** kan sprede sig hurtigt, når det er tørt.
sentence.en: A wildfire can spread quickly when it is dry.

en skovl.explanation: "En skovl" means "a shovel", for lifting and moving things like sand, soil or snow.

sentence.da: Han fjerner sneen med en **skovl**.
sentence.en: He clears the snow with a shovel.

en skovsti.explanation: "En skovsti" means "a forest path". It is built from skov (forest) and sti (path), and the same skov starts en skovtur (a trip into the forest).

sentence.da: Vi gik langs en smal **skovsti** i går.
sentence.en: We walked along a narrow forest path yesterday.

en skraldebil.explanation: "En skraldebil" means "a garbage truck", the truck that collects trash from the bins.

sentence.da: Hver tirsdag kommer en **skraldebil** og henter vores skrald.
sentence.en: Every Tuesday a garbage truck comes and picks up our trash.

en skraldemand.explanation: "En skraldemand" means "a garbage collector". It is built from skrald (garbage) and mand (man), and mand ends many job words, such as en postmand (a mailman).

sentence.da: Vores **skraldemand** tager skraldet hver tirsdag.
sentence.en: Our garbage collector takes the garbage every Tuesday.

en skraldepose.explanation: "En skraldepose" means "a garbage bag". It is built from skrald (garbage) and en pose (a bag), and the same pose is in en indkøbspose (a shopping bag).

sentence.da: Jeg putter affaldet i en **skraldepose** og binder den.
sentence.en: I put the waste in a garbage bag and tie it.

en skraldespand.explanation: "En skraldespand" means "a trash can", a bin you throw garbage in, in the kitchen or on the street. It is built from skrald (garbage) and spand (bucket).

sentence.da: Jeg smider papiret i en **skraldespand**.
sentence.en: I throw the paper in a trash can.

en skranke.explanation: "En skranke" means "a counter", a high table that staff stand behind when they help you, for example at a bank, an airport or a hotel. In a food store, the table is usually called en disk (a serving table) instead.

sentence.da: Ved en **skranke** i lufthavnen kan du aflevere din kuffert.
sentence.en: At a counter in the airport you can hand in your suitcase.

en skribent.explanation: "En skribent" means "a writer", someone who writes texts as a job, especially articles for newspapers and magazines. Unlike en forfatter (an author), a skribent does not have to write books.

sentence.da: Som **skribent** skriver hun artikler til flere aviser.
sentence.en: As a writer, she writes articles for several newspapers.

en skrue.explanation: "En skrue" means "a screw". You turn it in with en skruetrækker (a screwdriver).

sentence.da: Hylden falder ned, fordi der mangler en **skrue**.
sentence.en: The shelf falls down because a screw is missing.

en skruetrækker.explanation: "En skruetrækker" means "a screwdriver", the tool you hold by the handle to turn a screw in or out. It is built from skrue (screw) and trækker (puller).

sentence.da: Jeg bruger en **skruetrækker** til at stramme skruen.
sentence.en: I use a screwdriver to tighten the screw.

en skrællekniv.explanation: "En skrællekniv" means "a paring knife", a small knife for peeling fruit and vegetables.

sentence.da: Jeg skræller æblet med en **skrællekniv**.
sentence.en: I peel the apple with a paring knife.

en skuespiller.explanation: "En skuespiller" means "an actor" in movies or on stage, and it is used for both men and women: Hun er en kendt skuespiller (She is a famous actor). It is built from skuespil (a play) and spiller (player).

sentence.da: Hun er **skuespiller** og arbejder på et teater.
sentence.en: She is an actor and works at a theater.

en skuespillerinde.explanation: "En skuespillerinde" means "an actress", a woman who plays roles in films, on TV or in the theater. Many women in the job now call themselves skuespiller (an actor), which works for everyone.

sentence.da: Hun er en kendt **skuespillerinde**, og hun har spillet i mange film.
sentence.en: She is a famous actress, and she has acted in many films.

en skuffe.explanation: "En skuffe" means "a drawer", the box in a desk, dresser or kitchen unit that you slide out to reach things.

sentence.da: Gaflerne ligger i en **skuffe** i køkkenet.
sentence.en: The forks are in a drawer in the kitchen.

en skuffelse.explanation: "En skuffelse" means "a disappointment". To say how you feel, use Jeg er skuffet (I am disappointed).

sentence.da: Det var en stor **skuffelse**, og jeg blev ked af det.
sentence.en: It was a big disappointment, and I felt sad.

en skulder.explanation: "En skulder" means "a shoulder". Danish says the shoulder where English says my shoulder: Jeg har ondt i skulderen (literally I have pain in the shoulder) means "My shoulder hurts". At trække på skuldrene means "to shrug".

sentence.da: Hun lægger sin arm om min **skulder**.
sentence.en: She puts her arm around my shoulder.

en skuldertaske.explanation: "En skuldertaske" means "a shoulder bag", a bag with a long strap that hangs from one shoulder. It is built from skulder (shoulder) and taske (bag).

sentence.da: En **skuldertaske** bærer man på skulderen.
sentence.en: You carry a shoulder bag on the shoulder.

en skulptur.explanation: "En skulptur" means "a sculpture", a figure or shape made by hand in stone, metal, wood or clay. Unlike something flat on a wall, you can walk around it.

sentence.da: I parken står en stor **skulptur** af bronze.
sentence.en: In the park stands a large sculpture made of bronze.

en skurk.explanation: "En skurk" means "a villain", the bad character in a story, film or game who works against the main character. For a real person, it means a crook.

sentence.da: Helten fanger til sidst den onde **skurk**.
sentence.en: In the end, the hero catches the evil villain.

en sky.explanation: "En sky" means "a cloud". There is also a different word sky that means "shy": Han er sky (He is shy). The sentence tells you which one is meant.

sentence.da: Der er en mørk **sky** på himlen.
sentence.en: There is a dark cloud in the sky.

en skygge.explanation: "En skygge" means "a shadow", and also "shade": Solen kaster en lang skygge (The sun throws a long shadow). Jeg sidder i skyggen (I am sitting in the shade).

sentence.da: Træet giver en dejlig **skygge** på varme dage.
sentence.en: The tree gives lovely shade on hot days.

en skyskraber.explanation: "En skyskraber" means "a skyscraper", a very tall building. The word is built the same way as in English, from sky (sky) and skrabe (to scrape).

sentence.da: Fra mit hotelvindue kan jeg se en høj **skyskraber**.
sentence.en: From my hotel window I can see a tall skyscraper.

en skytte.explanation: "En skytte" means "a shooter" and "a marksman", a person who shoots at a target with a gun or a bow, usually as a sport. The word names the person, while the action is at skyde (to shoot).

sentence.da: Han er en god **skytte** og rammer næsten altid skiven.
sentence.en: He is a good shooter and almost always hits the target.

en skål.explanation: "En skål" means "a bowl". The same word is also what you say when you raise a glass: Skål! (Cheers!).

sentence.da: Jeg spiser suppe af en **skål**.
sentence.en: I eat soup from a bowl.

en skæbne.explanation: "En skæbne" means "a fate" or "a destiny", the course of a life as if it were decided in advance. It also means what finally happens to a person or thing: Bygningens skæbne er uvis (The building's fate is uncertain).

sentence.da: Jeg tror ikke på **skæbne**, kun på hårdt arbejde.
sentence.en: I do not believe in fate, only in hard work.

en skærm.explanation: "En skærm" means "a screen", on a computer, phone or TV. A cinema uses et lærred (a big canvas screen) instead.

sentence.da: Min computer har en stor **skærm**.
sentence.en: My computer has a big screen.

en skøjte.explanation: "En skøjte" means "a skate", a boot with a thin metal blade underneath, for gliding on ice. The usual way to say to ice skate is at løbe på skøjter (literally to run on skates).

sentence.da: Man tager en **skøjte** på hver fod og glider hen over isen.
sentence.en: You put a skate on each foot and glide across the ice.

en skøjtebane.explanation: "En skøjtebane" means "an ice rink", a flat area of ice where people skate. Some towns set one up outdoors in winter. It is built from skøjte (skate) and bane (rink, court).

sentence.da: Om vinteren fryser de vandet til en **skøjtebane** i parken.
sentence.en: In winter they freeze the water into an ice rink in the park.

en skønhed.explanation: "En skønhed" means "a beauty", either the quality of being beautiful or a beautiful person or thing: Hun er en sand skønhed (She is a true beauty).

sentence.da: Jeg elsker naturens **skønhed**.
sentence.en: I love the beauty of nature.

en skønhedssalon.explanation: "En skønhedssalon" means "a beauty salon", a place where trained staff treat your face, hands and feet. Cutting hair is the job of en frisør (a hairdresser).

sentence.da: I en **skønhedssalon** kan man få lakeret neglene.
sentence.en: In a beauty salon you can have your nails painted.

en slags.explanation: "En slags" means "a kind of" and "a sort of". It is always en slags, even before et-words: en slags værelse (a kind of room).

sentence.da: Han bor i en **slags** hytte ved søen.
sentence.en: He lives in a kind of cabin by the lake.

en slagter.explanation: "En slagter" means "a butcher", someone who cuts up meat and sells it in a shop.

sentence.da: Min onkel er **slagter** og sælger kød.
sentence.en: My uncle is a butcher and sells meat.

en slange.explanation: "En slange" means "a snake": Der er en slange i haven (There is a snake in the garden). The same word also means a hose: en haveslange (a garden hose).

sentence.da: En **slange** har ingen ben og kryber på jorden.
sentence.en: A snake has no legs and crawls on the ground.

en slave.explanation: "En slave" means "a slave", a person who is owned by someone else and forced to work without pay. It can also describe someone who works far too hard: Han er slave af sit arbejde (He is a slave to his job).

sentence.da: I gamle dage kunne en rig mand eje en **slave**.
sentence.en: In the old days a rich man could own a slave.

en slette.explanation: "En slette" means "a plain", wide flat land with few or no hills. Do not mix it up with at slette (to delete), which looks the same: Jeg sletter filen (I delete the file).

sentence.da: Landet er en flad **slette** uden bjerge.
sentence.en: The land is a flat plain without mountains.

en slikbutik.explanation: "En slikbutik" means "a candy store", a shop that sells sweets. It is built from slik (candy) and butik (shop), and the same slik starts en slikpose (a bag of candy).

sentence.da: I en **slikbutik** kan du købe slik og chokolade.
sentence.en: In a candy store you can buy candy and chocolate.

en slikpind.explanation: "En slikpind" means "a lollipop". It is built from slik (candy) and pind (stick), and pind is also in spisepinde (chopsticks).

sentence.da: Barnet slikker på en **slikpind**.
sentence.en: The child licks a lollipop.

en slutning.explanation: "En slutning" means "an ending", for example of a film or a book. It is built from at slutte (to end).

sentence.da: Filmen har en meget sjov **slutning**.
sentence.en: The film has a very funny ending.

en slægt.explanation: "En slægt" means "a family line" and "a lineage", all the people in a family across many generations, going back to a common start. In biology, it also means "genus", a group of closely related kinds of plants or animals.

sentence.da: Vores **slægt** har boet på samme gård i mange generationer.
sentence.en: Our family line has lived on the same farm for many generations.

en slægtning.explanation: "En slægtning" means "a relative", a person in your wider family.

sentence.da: En **slægtning** fra Norge kommer på besøg i morgen.
sentence.en: A relative from Norway is coming to visit tomorrow.

en smag.explanation: "En smag" means "a taste": Jeg kan lide smagen af citron (I like the taste of lemon). It also means a person's taste: Vi har ikke samme smag (We do not have the same taste). The action is at smage (to taste).

sentence.da: Suppen har en dejlig **smag** af hvidløg.
sentence.en: The soup has a lovely taste of garlic.

en smagsprøve.explanation: "En smagsprøve" means "a taste" and "a sample", a small amount of food or drink you try before you decide to buy. Stores and markets often hand them out for free.

sentence.da: Jeg fik en **smagsprøve** af osten og købte et stykke.
sentence.en: I got a taste of the cheese and bought a piece.

en smartphone.explanation: "En smartphone" means "a smartphone". En mobil (a mobile phone) is the shorter everyday word and can mean any mobile phone.

sentence.da: Min **smartphone** har internet og kamera.
sentence.en: My smartphone has internet and a camera.

en smed.explanation: "En smed" means "a smith", a person who shapes metal after heating it until it is soft. On its own it mostly means a blacksmith, who works with iron. With a metal in front, it names a specialist: en guldsmed (a goldsmith).

sentence.da: En **smed** varmer jernet og former det med en hammer.
sentence.en: A smith heats the iron and shapes it with a hammer.

en smerte.explanation: "En smerte" means "a pain". It is mostly used in the plural: Jeg har smerter means "I am in pain". For a pain in one place, Danes often say ondt, as in Jeg har ondt i hovedet (literally I have pain in the head, meaning "my head hurts").

sentence.da: Jeg har en skarp **smerte** i foden.
sentence.en: I have a sharp pain in my foot.

en smoothie.explanation: "En smoothie" means "a smoothie", a thick drink made of blended fruit.

sentence.da: Til morgenmad drikker jeg en **smoothie** med bær.
sentence.en: For breakfast I drink a smoothie with berries.

en sms.explanation: "En sms" means "a text message", said es-em-es. For messages in chat apps, Danes usually say en besked (a message).

sentence.da: Jeg skriver en kort **sms** til dig.
sentence.en: I write a short text message to you.

en småkage.explanation: "En småkage" means "a cookie" or "a biscuit", a small sweet treat. It is built from små (small) and kage (cake), and the same kage ends en lagkage (a layer cake).

sentence.da: Må jeg få en **småkage** til min te?
sentence.en: May I have a cookie with my tea?

en smørkniv.explanation: "En smørkniv" means "a butter knife", the blunt knife for spreading butter on bread.

sentence.da: Giv mig en **smørkniv** til brødet.
sentence.en: Give me a butter knife for the bread.

en snack.explanation: "En snack" means "a snack". Another way to say it is en bid mad (a bite of food).

sentence.da: Jeg spiser en **snack** før middag.
sentence.en: I eat a snack before dinner.

en snaps.explanation: "En snaps" means "a schnapps", a strong, clear drink served ice cold in a very small glass, often with herring or at holiday meals. The word covers both the drink and one small glass of it: Vi tager en snaps (We have a schnapps).

sentence.da: Til frokost drikker mange en lille, kold **snaps** til sild.
sentence.en: At lunch many people drink a small, cold schnapps with herring.

en sneaker.explanation: "En sneaker" means "a sneaker", a casual shoe you can wear for sport or every day. It is mostly used in the plural: Jeg har hvide sneakers på (I am wearing white sneakers).

sentence.da: En **sneaker** er en blød sko med gummisål.
sentence.en: A sneaker is a soft shoe with a rubber sole.

en snedker.explanation: "En snedker" means "a joiner" and "a cabinetmaker", a craftsman who makes fine woodwork such as tables, doors and shelves in a workshop. Someone who builds roofs and the wooden frames of houses is en tømrer (a carpenter).

sentence.da: Vores **snedker** har bygget et nyt køkken til os.
sentence.en: Our joiner has built a new kitchen for us.

en snegl.explanation: "En snegl" means "a snail" and "a slug": Danish uses one word for both. At the bakery, a snegl is also a spiral-shaped pastry.

sentence.da: En **snegl** bærer sit hus på ryggen og bevæger sig langsomt.
sentence.en: A snail carries its house on its back and moves slowly.

en snemand.explanation: "En snemand" means "a snowman", built from sne (snow) and mand (man). The same sne starts en snestorm (a snowstorm).

sentence.da: Børnene bygger en stor **snemand** i haven.
sentence.en: The children are building a big snowman in the yard.

en snerydning.explanation: "En snerydning" means "a snow removal", the work of clearing snow from roads and paths. Often the town clears the roads, while owners clear the sidewalk outside their own house.

sentence.da: Byen sørger for **snerydning** på de store veje.
sentence.en: The city takes care of snow removal on the big roads.

en snestorm.explanation: "En snestorm" means "a snowstorm". It is built from sne (snow) and storm (storm), and storm also ends en tordenstorm (a thunderstorm).

sentence.da: Der kom en kraftig **snestorm** i nat.
sentence.en: A strong snowstorm came last night.

en snigskytte.explanation: "En snigskytte" means "a sniper", a marksman who stays hidden and shoots at a target from far away. The first part comes from at snige (to sneak), which fits the secret way the person works.

sentence.da: Soldaten blev ramt af en **snigskytte** fra et hustag.
sentence.en: The soldier was hit by a sniper from a rooftop.

en snog.explanation: "En snog" means "a grass snake", a snake with a yellow patch behind its head that is often found near water and in gardens.

sentence.da: Den ufarlige **snog** svømmer over søen.
sentence.en: The harmless grass snake swims across the lake.

en snor.explanation: "En snor" means "a string" or "a cord", thin and light: Dragen holdes i en lang snor (The kite is held on a long string). It can also be a dog leash: Hunden skal i snor (The dog must be on a leash).

sentence.da: Hun bandt en **snor** om pakken.
sentence.en: She tied a string around the package.

en socialrådgiver.explanation: "En socialrådgiver" means "a social worker", a trained person who helps people in hard situations, such as families in trouble or people without work. Most work for the municipality.

sentence.da: En **socialrådgiver** hjælper folk med penge og bolig.
sentence.en: A social worker helps people with money and housing.

en sodavand.explanation: "En sodavand" means "a soda", a fizzy soft drink such as cola or lemonade. It is built from soda (soda water) and vand (water).

sentence.da: En **sodavand** er sød og har bobler.
sentence.en: A soda is sweet and has bubbles.

en sodavandsis.explanation: "En sodavandsis" means "a popsicle", a frozen fruity ice on a stick. It is built from sodavand (soda) and is (ice).

sentence.da: En **sodavandsis** er frossen sodavand på en pind.
sentence.en: A popsicle is frozen soda on a stick.

en sofa.explanation: "En sofa" means "a sofa" or "a couch". The low table in front of it is et sofabord (a coffee table), built from sofa and bord (table).

sentence.da: Vi sidder på en blød **sofa**.
sentence.en: We sit on a soft sofa.

en sok.explanation: "En sok" means "a sock", something you wear on your foot, usually under a shoe. Socks come in twos, so you count them as et par sokker (a pair of socks).

sentence.da: Jeg har en **sok** på min venstre fod.
sentence.en: I have a sock on my left foot.

en sol.explanation: "En sol" means "a sun", but you mostly hear it as solen (the sun): Solen skinner means "The sun is shining". It is also part of solskin (sunshine) and solbriller (sunglasses).

sentence.da: Der er meget **sol** i dag.
sentence.en: There is a lot of sun today.

en solcelle.explanation: "En solcelle" means "a solar cell", the small part that catches light from the sun. Many cells side by side form et solcelleanlæg (a solar installation), found on roofs and in fields.

sentence.da: Hver **solcelle** laver sollys om til strøm.
sentence.en: Each solar cell turns sunlight into electricity.

en soldat.explanation: "En soldat" means "a soldier", a person who serves in a country's armed forces. The stress is on the end: sol-DAT.

sentence.da: En **soldat** har uniform på og kæmper for sit land.
sentence.en: A soldier wears a uniform and fights for his country.

en solhat.explanation: "En solhat" means "a sun hat", a hat that keeps the sun off your face. It is built from sol (sun) and hat (hat).

sentence.da: Jeg tager min **solhat** på, når solen skinner.
sentence.en: I put on my sun hat when the sun is shining.

en solnedgang.explanation: "En solnedgang" means "a sunset". It is built from sol (sun) and nedgang (going down), and nedgang also means a drop in numbers: en nedgang i priserne (a drop in prices).

sentence.da: Vi ser en **solnedgang** fra stranden.
sentence.en: We watch a sunset from the beach.

en solopgang.explanation: "En solopgang" means "a sunrise". It is built from sol (sun) and opgang (going up), and opgang is also the stairwell entrance of an apartment building: Vi bor i opgang 3 (We live in entrance 3).

sentence.da: Vi står tidligt op og ser en **solopgang**.
sentence.en: We get up early and watch a sunrise.

en solsikke.explanation: "En solsikke" means "a sunflower", a tall plant with a big yellow head that turns toward the light. It starts with sol (sun).

sentence.da: Den høje **solsikke** vender sig mod solen.
sentence.en: The tall sunflower turns toward the sun.

en solskoldning.explanation: "En solskoldning" means "a sunburn", red and sore skin after too long in the sun. The second part skoldning (a scald) normally comes from hot water, so the sun is said to scald the skin.

sentence.da: Hun glemte solcreme og fik en slem **solskoldning**.
sentence.en: She forgot sunscreen and got a bad sunburn.

en solsort.explanation: "En solsort" means "a blackbird", a common garden bird with a lovely song. The male is black with a yellow beak.

sentence.da: En **solsort** synger i træet foran huset.
sentence.en: A blackbird sings in the tree in front of the house.

en sommelier.explanation: "En sommelier" means "a sommelier", a wine expert in a restaurant. It is a French job title that Danish uses unchanged, and you mostly meet it in fine restaurants.

sentence.da: Vores **sommelier** anbefaler en rød vin til oksekødet.
sentence.en: Our sommelier recommends a red wine with the beef.

en sommer.explanation: "En sommer" means "a summer", the warm season after spring and before autumn. To say in the summer, use om sommeren: Om sommeren er det lyst længe (In the summer it stays light late).

sentence.da: I **sommer** bader vi i havet.
sentence.en: This summer we swim in the sea.

en sommerdag.explanation: "En sommerdag" means "a summer day". It is built from sommer (summer) and dag (day), and the same sommer starts en sommerferie (a summer vacation).

sentence.da: Det er en varm **sommerdag**, og vi svømmer i havet.
sentence.en: It is a warm summer day, and we are swimming in the sea.

en sommerferie.explanation: "En sommerferie" means "a summer vacation". It is built from sommer (summer) and ferie (vacation), and you say i sommerferien (during the summer vacation).

sentence.da: I vores **sommerferie** bader vi i havet.
sentence.en: During our summer vacation we swim in the sea.

en sommerfest.explanation: "En sommerfest" means "a summer party", a party held in the warm months, often outside.

sentence.da: Vi holder **sommerfest** i haven, når det er varmt.
sentence.en: We have a summer party in the garden when it is warm.

en sommerfugl.explanation: "En sommerfugl" means "a butterfly", an insect with colorful wings that you mostly see in warm weather. It is built from sommer (summer) and fugl (bird), so it is literally a summer bird.

sentence.da: En **sommerfugl** har store vinger og flyver fra blomst til blomst.
sentence.en: A butterfly has big wings and flies from flower to flower.

en sommerkjole.explanation: "En sommerkjole" means "a summer dress", a light dress for warm days. It is built from sommer (summer) and kjole (dress). Sommer also starts en sommerferie (a summer vacation).

sentence.da: Hun har en gul **sommerkjole** på til festen.
sentence.en: She is wearing a yellow summer dress to the party.

en sommernat.explanation: "En sommernat" means "a summer night". Danish summer nights are short and light: Det er stadig lyst klokken ti (It is still light at ten o'clock).

sentence.da: Vi sover med åbent vindue på en varm **sommernat**.
sentence.en: We sleep with the window open on a warm summer night.

en sosu-assistent.explanation: "En sosu-assistent" means "a health care assistant", someone who helps sick or older people with daily care. When you say what someone does for work, leave out en: Hun er sosu-assistent (She is a health care assistant).

sentence.da: Min mor arbejder som **sosu-assistent** på et plejehjem.
sentence.en: My mother works as a health care assistant at a nursing home.

en souvenir.explanation: "En souvenir" means "a souvenir", a small thing you bring home from a trip.

sentence.da: Jeg købte en lille **souvenir** til min mor.
sentence.en: I bought a small souvenir for my mother.

en sovepose.explanation: "En sovepose" means "a sleeping bag". It is built from sove (to sleep) and pose (bag). Sove also starts en sovesofa (a sofa bed) and et soveværelse (a bedroom).

sentence.da: Jeg fryser ikke, fordi min **sovepose** er varm.
sentence.en: I am not cold because my sleeping bag is warm.

en sovesofa.explanation: "En sovesofa" means "a sofa bed", a sofa that folds out into a bed. It is built from sove (to sleep) and sofa (sofa).

sentence.da: Gæsterne kan sove i vores **sovesofa**.
sentence.en: The guests can sleep in our sofa bed.

en sovs.explanation: "En sovs" means "a sauce" or "gravy". Tomatsovs (tomato sauce) is made from it. The spelling en sauce (a sauce) is also used.

sentence.da: Frikadellerne smager godt med brun **sovs**.
sentence.en: The meatballs taste good with brown gravy.

en spade.explanation: "En spade" means "a spade", a tool with a flat metal blade on a long handle. You push the blade into the ground with your foot.

sentence.da: Med en **spade** kan man grave huller i jorden.
sentence.en: With a spade you can dig holes in the ground.

en spand.explanation: "En spand" means "a bucket", for water, sand or cleaning: Hent en spand vand (Get a bucket of water). You do not need af (of) between the two words.

sentence.da: Jeg fylder en **spand** med varmt vand.
sentence.en: I fill a bucket with hot water.

en spanier.explanation: "En spanier" means "a Spaniard", a person from Spain. For things from Spain, use spansk instead: spansk vin (Spanish wine) and spansk mad (Spanish food).

sentence.da: Han er **spanier**, men han bor i Danmark nu.
sentence.en: He is Spanish, but he lives in Denmark now.

en speciallæge.explanation: "En speciallæge" means "a specialist", a doctor with extra training in one area, such as the heart or the skin. Often you need a note from your own doctor before you can book one.

sentence.da: Min egen læge sendte mig videre til en **speciallæge**.
sentence.en: My own doctor sent me on to a specialist.

en speeder.explanation: "En speeder" means "an accelerator", the pedal you press to go faster. The pedal you use to slow down is en bremse (a brake).

sentence.da: En **speeder** får bilen til at køre hurtigere.
sentence.en: An accelerator makes the car go faster.

en spejder.explanation: "En spejder" means "a scout", a member of a youth group that learns to live and work together outdoors. It comes from at spejde (to look out).

sentence.da: Som **spejder** lærer man at klare sig ude i naturen.
sentence.en: As a scout you learn to manage out in nature.

en spids.explanation: "En spids" means "a tip" or "a point", the narrow end of something: spidsen af næsen (the tip of the nose). It can also be spids (pointed), like en spids kniv (a pointed knife).

sentence.da: Min blyant har en brækket **spids**.
sentence.en: My pencil has a broken tip.

en spidsmus.explanation: "En spidsmus" means "a shrew", a tiny animal that looks like a mouse but has a longer, pointed nose. The name means "pointed mouse".

sentence.da: En **spidsmus** spiser insekter og orme, ikke korn.
sentence.en: A shrew eats insects and worms, not grain.

en spillefilm.explanation: "En spillefilm" means "a feature film", a full-length film in which actors play out a made-up story, unlike a film about real events.

sentence.da: En **spillefilm** varer ofte halvanden time og har skuespillere.
sentence.en: A feature film often lasts an hour and a half and has actors.

en spiller.explanation: "En spiller" means "a player" in a game or sport. It also works for music: en guitarspiller (a guitar player).

sentence.da: En **spiller** løber efter bolden på banen.
sentence.en: A player runs after the ball on the field.

en spion.explanation: "En spion" means "a spy", someone who secretly gets information for another country or company. The matching verb is at spionere (to spy).

sentence.da: En **spion** arbejder i hemmelighed for et andet land.
sentence.en: A spy works in secret for another country.

en spiral.explanation: "En spiral" means "a spiral", a shape that winds around and around, like a spring.

sentence.da: Trappen snor sig op i en **spiral**.
sentence.en: The stairs wind up in a spiral.

en spiseske.explanation: "En spiseske" means "a tablespoon", the big spoon used for measuring in recipes. It is built from at spise (to eat) and ske (spoon).

sentence.da: Opskriften kræver en **spiseske** smør.
sentence.en: The recipe needs a tablespoon of butter.

en spisestue.explanation: "En spisestue" means "a dining room", the room with the dining table. It is built from spise (to eat) and stue (living room).

sentence.da: Vi spiser aftensmad i en stor **spisestue**.
sentence.en: We eat dinner in a big dining room.

en spisning.explanation: "En spisning" means "a shared meal", an event that people organize together, for example for a club. For an ordinary meal, say et måltid (a meal).

sentence.da: Vi laver mad sammen til klubbens **spisning**.
sentence.en: We cook together for the club's shared meal.

en sportsforretning.explanation: "En sportsforretning" means "a sports store", a place that sells shoes, clothes and gear for sport. Forretning also means a business in general: Han har en forretning (He has a business).

sentence.da: Du kan købe bolde og sko i en **sportsforretning**.
sentence.en: You can buy balls and shoes in a sports store.

en sportsgren.explanation: "En sportsgren" means "a sport", one particular kind of sport among many, such as soccer or handball. Gren means a branch of a tree, so a sportsgren is a branch of the whole.

sentence.da: Svømning er en populær **sportsgren** i Danmark.
sentence.en: Swimming is a popular sport in Denmark.

en sportsklub.explanation: "En sportsklub" means "a sports club", a group where people train and play together. It is built from sport (sport) and klub (club).

related.en: another word for a sports club

sentence.da: Jeg træner to gange om ugen i min **sportsklub**.
sentence.en: I work out twice a week at my sports club.

en sportstaske.explanation: "En sportstaske" means "a gym bag", a bag for your sports clothes and shoes. It is built from sport (sport) and taske (bag).

sentence.da: Jeg pakker tøj og sko i min **sportstaske**.
sentence.en: I pack clothes and shoes in my gym bag.

en sporvogn.explanation: "En sporvogn" means "a tram", an electric vehicle that runs on rails in the street. It is built from spor (track) and vogn (carriage).

sentence.da: Vi tager en **sporvogn** gennem den gamle by.
sentence.en: We take a tram through the old town.

en sprogskole.explanation: "En sprogskole" means "a language school", a school where adults learn a new language. To say you attend one, use på and leave out en: Jeg går på sprogskole (I go to language school).

sentence.da: Jeg lærer dansk på en **sprogskole** i byen.
sentence.en: I am learning Danish at a language school in town.

en sprøjte.explanation: "En sprøjte" means "a syringe" and "a sprayer". Both push a liquid out through a small opening. In the garden, a sprayer sends it as a fine mist over the plants.

sentence.da: Med en **sprøjte** kan lægen give medicin direkte i kroppen.
sentence.en: With a syringe the doctor can give medicine directly into the body.

en spurv.explanation: "En spurv" means "a sparrow", a small brown bird that lives close to people in towns and gardens.

sentence.da: Den lille brune fugl i haven er en **spurv**.
sentence.en: The little brown bird in the garden is a sparrow.

en spændingsroman.explanation: "En spændingsroman" means "a thriller (novel)", a book with a tense plot, such as a crime or a chase. It is built from spænding (excitement) and roman (novel).

sentence.da: I en **spændingsroman** vil man vide, hvem der gjorde det.
sentence.en: In a thriller you want to know who did it.

en spøg.explanation: "En spøg" means "a joke" or "a prank", something said or done for fun and not meant seriously. For a joke with a punchline, Danes often say en vits (a joke) instead.

sentence.da: Det var kun en **spøg**, og alle grinede.
sentence.en: It was only a joke, and everyone laughed.

en squash.explanation: "En squash" means "a zucchini". The sport has the same name but no en: Han spiller squash (He plays squash).

sentence.da: Jeg skærer en **squash** i tynde skiver.
sentence.en: I cut a zucchini into thin slices.

en squat.explanation: "En squat" means "a squat", the exercise where you bend your knees and go down, then stand up again. To say you do squats, Danes use lave (to do): Jeg laver ti squats (I do ten squats).

sentence.da: Jeg bøjer knæene i en dyb **squat**.
sentence.en: I bend my knees in a deep squat.

en stagnation.explanation: "En stagnation" means "a stagnation", a time when something stops developing, such as an economy or a business.

sentence.da: Efter en lang **stagnation** begyndte firmaet endelig at vokse igen.
sentence.en: After a long stagnation the firm finally began to grow again.

en stak.explanation: "En stak" means "a stack", things placed neatly on top of each other: en stak tallerkener (a stack of plates). A messy one is en bunke (a pile).

sentence.da: Der ligger en høj **stak** bøger på bordet.
sentence.en: There is a tall stack of books on the table.

en stakkel.explanation: "En stakkel" means "a poor thing", a person you feel sorry for. Before a name or a pronoun, Danes use stakkels: stakkels Peter (poor Peter).

sentence.da: Din **stakkel**, du er helt gennemblødt af regnen.
sentence.en: You poor thing, you are completely soaked by the rain.

en stald.explanation: "En stald" means "a stable", the building where farm animals sleep and stay warm. It is not only for horses; it is used for cows and pigs too.

sentence.da: Vi har en stor **stald** til hestene.
sentence.en: We have a big stable for the horses.

en stamme.explanation: "En stamme" has two meanings: "a tribe", a group of people with a shared language and way of life, and "a trunk", the thick main part of a tree. Context shows which one is meant. The same spelling is also at stamme (to stutter).

sentence.da: Den gamle eg har en meget tyk **stamme**.
sentence.en: The old oak has a very thick trunk.

en stand.explanation: "En stand" means "a stand / booth", a small place where goods are shown or sold at a fair or market.

sentence.da: På messen har hver virksomhed sin egen **stand**.
sentence.en: At the trade show each company has its own booth.

en stank.explanation: "En stank" means "a stench", a very bad smell. A neutral smell is en lugt (a smell), and a nice one is en duft (a scent).

sentence.da: Der er en forfærdelig **stank** i køkkenet.
sentence.en: There is a terrible stench in the kitchen.

en startup.explanation: "En startup" means "a startup", a new business, often small and built around a new idea. Danes use the English word as it is.

sentence.da: Hun er iværksætter og har startet en **startup** med to venner.
sentence.en: She is an entrepreneur and has started a startup with two friends.

en stat.explanation: "En stat" means "a state", a country with its own government, or one of the parts of a country, such as the American states. Staten (the state) can also mean the national government, as opposed to the local municipality.

sentence.da: Hver **stat** i USA har sin egen guvernør.
sentence.en: Each state in the USA has its own governor.

en station.explanation: "En station" means "a station", a place where trains, metros or buses stop. På stationen means "at the station". For trains only, you can also say en togstation (a train station).

sentence.da: Vi venter på toget på en **station**.
sentence.en: We wait for the train at a station.

en statistik.explanation: "En statistik" means "a statistic", a collection of figures that shows how often something happens. Without en, statistik is also the school subject: Hun læser statistik (She studies statistics).

sentence.da: Ifølge den nye **statistik** ryger færre unge i dag.
sentence.en: According to the new statistics, fewer young people smoke today.

en statsadvokat.explanation: "En statsadvokat" means "a public prosecutor", an official who works for the state and presents criminal cases in court against the accused. The job is the opposite of a defense attorney, en forsvarer, who works for the accused.

sentence.da: En **statsadvokat** fører sagen mod den anklagede i retten.
sentence.en: A public prosecutor handles the case against the accused in court.

en statsleder.explanation: "En statsleder" means "a head of state", the person at the top of a country. In Denmark that is the monarch, while the statsminister (prime minister) leads the government instead. The word is common in news about meetings between countries.

sentence.da: En **statsleder** repræsenterer sit land over for andre lande.
sentence.en: A head of state represents their country to other countries.

en statsminister.explanation: "En statsminister" means "a prime minister", the head of a government. It is built from stat (state) and minister (minister).

sentence.da: Danmarks **statsminister** leder landets regering.
sentence.en: Denmark's prime minister leads the country's government.

en statue.explanation: "En statue" means "a statue", a figure of a person or an animal made of stone or metal.

sentence.da: Der står en gammel **statue** af en konge.
sentence.en: There is an old statue of a king.

en status.explanation: "En status" means "a status", how things stand right now. It can also mean a short summary of that: Vi laver en status hver fredag (We give a progress summary every Friday).

sentence.da: Chefen vil have en **status** på arbejdet i dag.
sentence.en: The boss wants a status update on the work today.

en stavelse.explanation: "En stavelse" means "a syllable", one beat in a spoken word. The word banan has two: ba-nan.

sentence.da: Den første **stavelse** i ordet kaffe er kaf.
sentence.en: The first syllable in the word kaffe (coffee) is kaf.

en stedfar.explanation: "En stedfar" means "a stepfather", your mother's husband when he is not your birth father. It is built from sted- (step) and far (father).

sentence.da: Min mor er gift med min **stedfar**, ikke min far.
sentence.en: My mother is married to my stepfather, not my father.

en stedmor.explanation: "En stedmor" means "a stepmother", your father's wife when she is not your birth mother. It is built from sted- (step) and mor (mother).

sentence.da: Min far er gift med min **stedmor**, ikke min mor.
sentence.en: My father is married to my stepmother, not my mother.

en stegepande.explanation: "En stegepande" means "a frying pan". It is stege (to fry) and pande (pan) joined into one word. You can also say just en pande (a pan).

sentence.da: Jeg steger æg på en varm **stegepande**.
sentence.en: I fry eggs in a hot frying pan.

en stegning.explanation: "En stegning" means "a frying", the act of cooking food in hot fat or in an oven until it is browned.

sentence.da: Ved **stegning** skal panden være meget varm.
sentence.en: When frying, the pan must be very hot.

en stemme.explanation: "En stemme" means "a voice" and also "a vote": Hun har en smuk stemme (She has a beautiful voice). Hver stemme tæller (Every vote counts).

sentence.da: Hendes **stemme** er blød og rolig.
sentence.en: Her voice is soft and calm.

en stemmeseddel.explanation: "En stemmeseddel" means "a ballot", the paper where you mark your choice on polling day.

sentence.da: Du sætter et kryds på din **stemmeseddel**.
sentence.en: You put a cross on your ballot.

en stemning.explanation: "En stemning" means "a mood" or "an atmosphere", the feeling in a room or group: Der var god stemning til festen (The mood at the party was good). It is about the whole place, not one person.

sentence.da: Der er en rar **stemning** i klassen.
sentence.en: There is a nice atmosphere in the class.

en sten.explanation: "En sten" means "a stone" or "a rock". The plural sten looks the same as the singular, so mange sten means "many stones". As a material, it is used alone, with no en.

sentence.da: Muren er lavet af **sten**.
sentence.en: The wall is made of stone.

en stewardesse.explanation: "En stewardesse" means "a flight attendant", a woman who helps passengers on a plane. A man is en steward (a male flight attendant).

sentence.da: Hun arbejder som **stewardesse** og rejser meget.
sentence.en: She works as a flight attendant and travels a lot.

en sti.explanation: "En sti" means "a path", a narrow way for walking in a forest or field, with no cars.

sentence.da: Den lille **sti** går gennem skoven og ned til søen.
sentence.en: The little path goes through the forest and down to the lake.

en stige.explanation: "En stige" means "a ladder". It looks like the verb at stige (to rise or go up): Prisen stiger (The price is going up).

sentence.da: Han står på en **stige** og skifter pæren.
sentence.en: He is standing on a ladder and changing the bulb.

en stigning.explanation: "En stigning" means "a rise / increase", an upward change in an amount, for example in the temperature. It can also be a slope that climbs.

sentence.da: Der har været en stor **stigning** i priserne på mad.
sentence.en: There has been a big rise in the price of food.

en stikdåse.explanation: "En stikdåse" means "a power strip", a block with several sockets, so many devices can share one wall outlet.

sentence.da: Jeg kan sætte fem ting i den nye **stikdåse**.
sentence.en: I can plug five things into the new power strip.

en stikkontakt.explanation: "En stikkontakt" means "an outlet" in the wall, where you plug things in. The plug itself is et stik.

sentence.da: Jeg sætter min oplader i en **stikkontakt**.
sentence.en: I put my charger in an outlet.

en stikling.explanation: "En stikling" means "a cutting", a small piece cut from a living plant that can start growing on its own. Gardeners use it to copy a favorite: at tage stiklinger (to take cuttings).

sentence.da: Hun satte en **stikling** i et glas vand.
sentence.en: She put a cutting in a glass of water.

en stil.explanation: "En stil" means "a style", the way someone dresses or does things.

sentence.da: Jeg kan godt lide din **stil**, især dine sko.
sentence.en: I like your style, especially your shoes.

en stilling.explanation: "En stilling" means "a position", especially a job: Hun søger en stilling som lærer (She is applying for a job as a teacher). In sports, it is the score: Stillingen er 2-1 (The score is 2-1).

sentence.da: Hun har fået en ny **stilling** i Aarhus.
sentence.en: She has gotten a new job in Aarhus.

en stillingsannonce.explanation: "En stillingsannonce" means "a job ad", an advertisement where an employer says it is looking for a new worker.

sentence.da: Jeg fandt en **stillingsannonce**, og jeg vil søge jobbet.
sentence.en: I found a job ad, and I want to apply for the job.

en stirren.explanation: "En stirren" means "a stare", a long, hard look at someone or something without looking away. It often makes the other person uncomfortable.

sentence.da: Hans lange **stirren** fik hende til at se væk.
sentence.en: His long stare made her look away.

en stjerne.explanation: "En stjerne" means "a star", either in the sky or as a rating. A hotel with fem stjerner has five stars.

sentence.da: Om natten ser vi en **stjerne** på himlen.
sentence.en: At night we see a star in the sky.

en stol.explanation: "En stol" means "a chair". In Danish, you sit på (on) a chair: Sæt dig på stolen (Sit down on the chair).

sentence.da: Jeg sidder på en **stol** ved bordet.
sentence.en: I am sitting on a chair at the table.

en storby.explanation: "En storby" means "a big city", a large city with many people. It is the opposite of en landsby (a village).

sentence.da: Jeg vil bo i en **storby**, fordi der sker meget.
sentence.en: I want to live in a big city because a lot happens there.

en storebror.explanation: "En storebror" means "a big brother": any brother who is older than you, whatever the age gap.

sentence.da: Min **storebror** er ti år ældre end mig.
